dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: These devices... I don't know what they're called, but they're so cool!

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Oh, so these devices are all lifted up by the power of the moon? Do you think in the future boats will be lifted up by the moon, too? Then we won't need to sail them! That's so neat — no wonder it's called Coolvahki!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be cool, but it still comes from the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: You're right! No wonder the captain was yelling at us to hurry up — as soon as we're ready, we can get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: It can't be easy being a Fatuus these days. It's not enough to know how to fight, you've gotta learn to operate all this advanced stuff too... *sigh* Do you think they give training to newcomers?

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Good luck to you, too! This place has so much interesting stuff — like those crates follow that track and enter the warehouse all by themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Really? Are you sure? You look like you know a thing or two, so I guess I'll take your word for it.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Someone like you, I bet you have an interesting job. Not like me, all I'm cut out for is a life on the seas. But I don't want to waste my whole life away sailing the oceans.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: The upside is, merchant ships like ours get to see a lot of places. I'm sure to find an interesting job one day as well!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you want to join the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: I wouldn't go that far. I hear their casualty rate is through the roof, and I'm not all that keen to risk my neck. I just think everything here's pretty interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: After all, does anyone really want to be a sailor for the rest of their lives? Then again, being a sailor has its perks — you never know what sort of interesting people or things you're gonna find at your next port of call.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know what the Fatui are shipping?

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Shh... Don't let the captain overhear you! He keeps drumming into us the importance of keeping shtum when it comes to customers' affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I'd like to know myself. But those boxes... They're packed in tighter than fish in a trawler's hold. There's no way anyone's seeing into them...
